description: mapy.opolskie.pl: flood hazard datasets (zdjecia powodz) is a collection of datasets listed in Geoportal Opole Province, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mapy.opolskie.pl. Coverage: the area served by mapy.opolskie.pl. The listing groups 277 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Zdjęcia „Powódź 1997”, panchromatyczne, szereg 23, zdjęcie 3189; Zdjęcia „Powódź 1997”, RGB, M-34-49-6523; Zdjęcia „Powódź 1997”, panchromatyczne, szereg 13, zdjęcie 3322; Zdjęcia „Powódź 1997”, RGB, M-33-48-6711. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-opole.
